title: poa glauca subsp. altaica
intro: Poa glauca subsp. altaica, commonly known as Siberian blue grass, is a subspecies of the Poa glauca plant, a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Poa glauca subsp. altaica include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
